Container.Name: bonsai-prism-vulkan
Container.Overview: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B served by PrismML's llama.cpp fork on AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) via Vulkan (RADV). [br]Default model: Ternary-Bonsai-2.5-27B-PTQ1_0-mtp.gguf (~6 GB) for smallest footprint and faster decode via the embedded MTP draft head. Exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at /v1/chat/completions (works with Techo firmware or any OpenAI client). [br]Runtime config lives in /config/start.sh (seeded from this repo on first boot — edit it there to change model, context, KV cache, speculative settings, or extra args). No container environment variables are required. [br]Footprint-first defaults: -c 8192, -np 1, q4_0 KV cache, flash attention, draft-mtp (n-max 3, p-min 0.1). For fast HA/Techo responses, add --reasoning-budget 0 via EXTRA_ARGS if your build supports it. [br]Vulkan path: needs /dev/dri only (no /dev/kfd). Can run alongside ROCm containers in principle, but on 128 GB unified Strix Halo memory be careful when coexisting with large models (e.g. qwen38-flash-next-gufo uses ~87 GB). Stop large containers for a clean first trial.
Container.PostArgs: -c "if [ ! -s /config/start.sh ]; then curl -fsSL -o /config/start.sh.tmp https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iknox/unraid-templates/main/config-examples/bonsai-prism-vulkan.start.sh && mv /config/start.sh.tmp /config/start.sh || { rm -f /config/start.sh.tmp; echo 'failed to seed /config/start.sh'; exit 1; }; fi; exec bash /config/start.sh"
Container.Description: Strix Halo Vulkan llama-server for Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B PTQ1_0-mtp (PrismML fork). Host port 9932 maps to the server's 8080. Configure via /config/start.sh on the appdata share — no env vars. Requires /dev/dri; no /dev/kfd.

Config.Name: HTTP / API
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible llama-server API (WebUI at root, /v1/chat/completions for Techo/OpenAI clients).

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: GGUF files. Ternary-Bonsai-2.5-27B-PTQ1_0-mtp.gguf is downloaded to /models/bonsai-2.5-27b/ on first boot if AUTO_DOWNLOAD=1 in start.sh.

Config.Name: Runtime config
Config.Description: Holds start.sh — model path, context, KV cache, speculative decoding, and extra llama-server args. Seeded automatically on first boot; edit and restart to apply.
